description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different r, WikiHow” illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with the parameter shown on the x-axis for four finetuning method/model combinations. The x-axis is labeled “log r” and uses a linear scale with values from 0 to 9, shown at integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23 at log r = 0, rises through about 24.5 (log r = 1) and ~26.8 (log r = 2) to around 28.4–28.6 by log r = 3–5, then declines slightly to about 28.0 (log r = 6), ~27.6 (log r = 7), ~27.1 (log r = 8), and ~27.0 at log r = 9. The blue line (MBart + LoRA) starts near 12 at log r = 0, drops to about 5 at log r = 1, then increases to ~20.2 (log r = 2), ~24.4 (log r = 3), and ~27.0–27.2 by log r = 4–5, remaining roughly flat around ~27.1–27.2 through log r = 7 before ending near ~27.0 (log r = 8) and ~26.8 (log r = 9). The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) begins around 23 at log r = 0, increases to ~26.3 (log r = 1), ~30.0 (log r = 2), ~33.4 (log r = 3), and ~36.0 (log r = 4), then stays nearly constant around ~36.0–36.2 from log r = 5 through log r = 9. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 12 at log r = 0, rises to ~14 (log r = 1), ~21.3 (log r = 2), ~29.0 (log r = 3), ~31.2 (log r = 4), ~32.5 (log r = 5), ~33.0 (log r = 6), ~33.3 (log r = 7), ~33.4 (log r = 8), and ends around ~33.4 at log r = 9.
